_source: VASSAL module CombatCommanderEurope-2.6.4.vmod, buildFile.xml DrawPiles (Decks map); names read from the title bars of the card-layer images
_notes: One record per card: order / action / event names as printed in the title bars (no rules text).
dice: the two dice printed on the card; the module calls them white and red (report text "(1w,2r)").
trigger: printed above the dice: Jammed, Sniper, Event or Time (None = no trigger).
order_also_playable_as_action: Fire cards are printed ORDER / ACTION FIRE.
action_defender_only: the action title carries a DEFENDER ONLY tag.
Command Confusion cards print COMMAND CONFUSION in the order bar; those with no separate action print it again in the action bar (action = Command Confusion).
breeze_direction: 1..6 = the hexside compass printed on the map (1=N, 2=NE, 3=SE, 4=S, 5=SW, 6=NW).

Checks: every deck has 72 cards; every ordered dice pair (white,red) 1-1..6-6 appears exactly twice per deck; random hexes are unique per deck - German deck = all odd-numbered hexes except A1/H1/O1, Russian and American decks = all even-numbered hexes except A10/H10/O10.
module.layers lists the image layers that compose the card face in the module (bottom first); module.prototypes the VASSAL prototypes (DR-w-r[trigger], H-hex, O-/A-/AF-/E- = order/action/event).
